text:
Jun: morning all  hi — i'm Jun, product designer starting today. two quick blockers: i accepted the Figma invite but i cant see prototype branches or unpublished pages (shows empty list). also can't find the weekly roadmap notes in Notion. who should i ping for a 10-min setup?

Product Onboarding Bot: welcome Jun :tada:  Invite sent to jun@redwood.ai and add attempt scheduled. Roadmap: Notion > Product > Roadmap & Meeting Notes (https://redwood-internal.notion.site/Product-Roadmap-Notes). If Figma still hides unpublished pages try Figma menu -> File -> Show prototype branches or clear cache. Reply "manual add" to request admin.

Jun: tried the menu and cache clear, still empty.

Asha: hey Jun  welcome! i'm Asha (Design Ops)  i'll manually add you to the team and check library permissions. DM'd your figma email. Quick Q: do you need access to prototype branches and drafts or just published libraries?

Jun: prototype branches + drafts would be ideal so i can review recent iterations.

Asha: done — you should have "Can view prototypes" and drafts access now. if anything still missing, open the file URL directly and check "Share" permissions. i'll also add you to the Design critique invite.

Research Ops: Jun  added you to Research Notion and to the recordings Drive folder. Interview scripts and consent language are in Research > Playbooks > Templates. For past study takeaways, open the "synthesis" page inside each study; we keep highlights and recruit notes there.

Jun: awesome, i can see prototypes now. one last thing: what do PMs expect in the design section of a feature brief? a short list is fine.

Celia: welcome Jun  PM here  short checklist: 1) high-level problem + users, 2) proposed flows (screens or prototype), 3) success metrics & acceptance criteria, 4) token list + accessibility notes, 5) short research links (study id or synth). that lives on the PRD template in Notion.

Jun: perfect, thanks everyone  joining the critique later today :)
